# garage_key (Resource)

Manages a Garage access key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Auto-generate a new access key
resource "garage_key" "app" {
  name = "application-key"
}

# Import a predefined access key
resource "garage_key" "legacy" {
  id                = "GK0123456789abcdef01234567"
  secret_access_key = var.legacy_secret_key
  name              = "legacy-key"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `create_bucket` (Boolean) Whether this key is allowed to create buckets.
- `expiration` (String) Expiration date (RFC 3339). Mutually exclusive with never_expires.
- `id` (String) Access key ID. If set together with secret_access_key, imports a predefined key.
- `name` (String) Friendly name for the key.
- `never_expires` (Boolean) Set to true to make the key never expire.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key. Only available at creation or import with showSecretKey.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Key creation timestamp.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether the key has expired.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import garage_key.app <access-key-id>
```
